evaluation_notes.po_human_only: Use amass_sequence.npz and an empty scene.
evaluation_notes.rt_with_environment: Use benchmark_metadata.bundle_contents.environment_geometry.scene_path when present; otherwise the bundle is self-contained for human-only simulation and measured-ADC DSP validation.

motion.mesh_generation: generated from the AMASS parameters and a licensed SMPL model when simulation is run
motion.parameter_source: poses, translations, timing, and producer fields copied from the selected fitted segment without refitting; participant-specific betas and gender were replaced with zero betas and neutral gender for this public fixture

timing_fields.times: Original selected-segment local sample times in seconds.
timing_fields.source_capture_times: Absolute source capture times in seconds.
timing_fields.bundle_times: Times relative to the selected radar frame, which is t=0.
timing_fields.radar_capture_times: Absolute RT-Pose radar frame times in seconds.
